subject: Control alignment & evidence ingestion plan — HarborBank SIG package
messages:
From: Alex Curtiss <procurement@harborbank.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: Lara Patel <lara.patel@harborbank.com>, Trace Security <sig@tracesec.com>
Date: 2027-05-10T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Initial SIG/Control package ask for RFP HB-1127

Hi Evelyn,

Thanks for the intro call yesterday. HarborBank is compiling SIG questionnaire responses for the RB AI vendor assessment and we need a control-level crosswalk plus evidence ingestion plan by end of next week. Please confirm:

- Can Redwood provide a control-to-evidence crosswalk mapped to SIG v2026 (or ISO27001/SOC2 equivalents where applicable)?
- Do you have a standard artifact ingestion process we can use (SFTP, secure upload link, or shared Drive)?
- We will likely request logs and KMS key info; can you provide an expected list of artifacts and typical delivery times?

Attached is HarborBank's annotated SIG (harbor_SIG_2027_questions.xlsx) with a few high-priority callouts (encryption at rest, access reviews, long-term retention).

Appreciate a plan and timeline by next Wednesday (2027-05-12 COB).

Best,
Alex Curtiss
Senior Sourcing Manager
HarborBank
[Attachment: harbor_SIG_2027_questions.xlsx (Excel, 185 KB)]

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Initial SIG/Control package ask for RFP HB-1127

Folks — forwarding the HarborBank request. Key asks: control-to-evidence crosswalk mapped to SIG v2026, list of deliverables (logs, KMS snapshot, policies), and an ingestion method. Timeline: they want plan by 5/12 COB.

Proposed division of work:
- Diego: lead control mapping (SIG -> SOC2/ISO equivalents) and produce redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx
- Marissa: package artifacts list and ingestion steps; coordinate secure transfer method
- Jonas: vet any contractual constraints (redaction, retention) and confirm with Legal if necessary

Diego/Marissa — can you confirm feasibility and whether we need extra artifact pulls (e.g., full tokenization logs)? I can own the customer reply.

Thanks,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference | https://www.redwood.ai

From: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai
Cc: jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-10T11:34:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Fwd: Initial SIG/Control package ask for RFP HB-1127

Evelyn / team — can do. Quick notes after a first pass:

- I will map each SIG question to our SOC 2 controls and ISO27001 annex entries; final artifact expectations will be annotated per-row in redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx.
- Expected artifacts we will likely provide:
  * Configuration snapshots (access control lists, RBAC roles)
  * KMS key inventory (non-secret metadata CSV)
  * Aggregated access logs (redacted) for the requested quarter (we'll provide as compressed tar.gz)
  * Policy documents (retention, incident response, change management)
  * SOC 2 Type II report excerpt and scope summary (if allowed)

- Ingestion options: secure SFTP endpoint (our preferred), encrypted shared Drive folder (short-lived link), or HubSpot secure file exchange. For large log bundles we prefer SFTP.

Marissa — can you scope time to collect and sanitize logs (estimate: 2 business days once we have scope) and to stand up a short-lived SFTP account? I'll start the mapping and share the crosswalk by EOD 5/11.

Diego
Senior Security Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (Excel, 240 KB)]

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Alex Curtiss <procurement@harborbank.com>, Lara Patel <lara.patel@harborbank.com>, Trace Security <sig@tracesec.com>
Cc: diego_fernandez@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, jonas_weber@redwood.ai
Date: 2027-05-11T09:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Control alignment & evidence ingestion plan — HarborBank SIG package

Alex / Lara — thanks for the clear ask. Per internal workstreams below, here's our delivery plan and immediate requests: 

1) Control crosswalk: attached (redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx). It maps each HarborBank SIG row to our SOC 2/ISO counterparts and lists the preferred artifact type per control. Where we cannot provide control-level evidence (e.g., vendor-managed subcomponents), we flag and provide compensating evidence.

2) Artifact list & ingestion: proposed options:
   - Secure SFTP (recommended) — we will provision a short-lived account and an upload path for your team and Trace Security.
   - Encrypted shared Drive link (alternate) — acceptable for policy docs and small artifacts.

3) Expected artifacts (initial scope):
   - Aggregated access logs: redacted, compressed (we can provide Q4-2026 bundle)
   - KMS metadata snapshot (key IDs, rotation policies) — no key material included
   - Retention & incident response policies (PDFs)
   - System configuration snapshots and RBAC export (JSON)

4) Timeline:
   - 5/11 EOD: Control crosswalk (attached) + artifact manifest
   - 5/12 COB: SFTP credentials & first artifact batch (logs + policies)

5) Security notes: All artifacts will be labeled and hashed; we can redact user identifiers on request. We ask HarborBank to confirm any additional redaction requirements before ingestion.

Attachments: redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx, redwood_evidence_manifest_20270511.pdf

Next steps: Please confirm preferred ingestion method (SFTP vs Drive) and any additional evidence filters. Once confirmed we'll provision the SFTP account and share credentials via 2FA channel.

Best,
Evelyn Hart
Senior Solutions Engineer
Redwood Inference
[Attachments: redwood_control_crosswalk_v1.xlsx (Excel, 240 KB); redwood_evidence_manifest_20270511.pdf (PDF, 75 KB)]

From: Alex Curtiss <procurement@harborbank.com>
To: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, diego_fernandez@redwood.ai
Cc: Lara Patel <lara.patel@harborbank.com>, Trace Security <sig@tracesec.com>
Date: 2027-05-12T16:42:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Control alignment & evidence ingestion plan — HarborBank SIG package

Evelyn / Diego — thank you, that is exactly the level of detail we needed. HarborBank confirms SFTP as preferred ingestion channel and we accept the artifact manifest. A couple of clarifications from Trace Security:

- For the access logs, can you provide an example record layout (columns) so our tooling can ingest without schema surprises?
- For KMS metadata: please ensure the CSV contains key ID, creation date, rotation flag, and owner team (non-secret).

We'll send the SFTP account details for upload later today. Appreciate the quick turnaround — Trace Security will review the crosswalk and may submit two follow-up rows (minor).

Best regards,
Alex Curtiss
Senior Sourcing Manager
HarborBank
